meaning:
ὁρμάω, -ῶ
(ὁρμή), [in LXX for שׁוּב, etc. ;]
1. causal, to set in motion, urge on.
2. Intrans., to hasten on, rush: before εἰς, Mat.8:32, Mrk.5:13, Luk.8:33, Act.19:29; ἐπί, with accusative, Act.7:57.†
(AS)
